Name: Teleporter Station
Description:
Adds a 1x1 teleporter station. A beaver instantly transports from one station to any other station of the same network.

[h1]Using it[/h1]
[list]
[*]Unlocks in the Paths menu for 5000 science. Costs 20 Planks, 20 Metal Blocks and 50 Extract.
[*]Teleporters live on one district: the first station placed on a district's paths binds them there. A teleporter cannot be placed on any other district's paths (for now).
[*]Every charged station of that district forms one network. Walk onto one, walk off any other.
[*]Stations work away from paths too: one on unclaimed ground joins the network through the wormhole.
[*]Membership is automatic. There is no connect button and no disconnect; demolish a station to remove it.
[/list]

[h1]Looks[/h1]
[list]
[*]The network's event horizon takes its color from the district.
[*]Spiral arms spin inside the horizon. A dry station is an inert ring.
[*]Iron Teeth get forged plank ramps. Folktails get walnut.
[/list]

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stations run on extract: one per ten crossings, drawn at the teleporter the beaver walks into. 100 max, hauled by the district.
[*]Wormhole siphon: a station that runs low pulls extract from a station you designate as the source.
[*]No dependencies.
[*]Safe to add to an existing save. Removing the mod removes the stations and nothing else.
[*]Tested on Timberborn 1.1.2.7.
[/list]

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
Older versions could strand a beaver mid-teleport, usually when a teleporter was removed. Current versions rework how teleport travel works and should fix it. If you catch it anyway, describe what was happening in the comments.

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
[list]
[*]Support for teleporters on more than one district.
[/list]
